<script async data-chunk="Footer" src="https://cdn.readme.io/public/hub/web/Footer.1b7490d3d8625b3ad4c4.js"></script></div><script id="customJS">$(window).on('pageLoad', function(e, state) {
    // Configuration constants
    const CONFIG = {
        INIT_DELAY: 900,
        DEBOUNCE_DELAY: 300,
        SELECTORS: {
            API_AUTH_SECTION: '.rm-APIAuth',
            TOKEN_SPANS: 'span.cm-string',
            CODE_MIRROR_PRE: '.CodeMirror pre'
        },
        STORAGE_KEY: 'originalTokens'
    };

    // Utility functions
    const utils = {
        debounce: function(func, wait) {
            let timeout;
            return function executedFunction(...args) {
                const later = () => {
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                    func(...args);
                };
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
            };
        },

        safeQuerySelectorAll: function(selector) {
            try {
                return document.querySelectorAll(selector);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`Error querying selector "${selector}":`, error);
                return [];
            }
        },

        getStoredTokens: function() {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_KEY)) || {};
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error retrieving stored tokens:', error);
                return {};
            }
        },

        setStoredTokens: function(tokens) {
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem(CONFIG.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(tokens));
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error storing tokens:', error);
            }
        }
    };

    // Wait for initialization
    setTimeout(function() {
        try {
            // Remove blur from API Auth section
            var section = document.querySelector(CONFIG.SELECTORS.API_AUTH_SECTION);
            if (section) {
                section.style.filter = 'none';
            } else {
                console.warn('.rm-APIAuth section not found');
            }

            // Retrieve original tokens from sessionStorage
            var originalTokens = utils.getStoredTokens();
            var tokensUpdated = false;

            // Improved function to mask Bearer tokens
            function maskTokens() {
                var tokenSpans = utils.safeQuerySelectorAll(CONFIG.SELECTORS.TOKEN_SPANS);
                var localUpdated = false;

                tokenSpans.forEach(function(span, index) {
                    if (!span.textContent.includes("Bearer")) return;

                    var tokenMatch = span.textContent.match(/Bearer (\S+)/);
                    if (!tokenMatch) return;

                    var tokenKey = 'Bearer' + index;
                    
                    // Store original token if not already stored
                    if (!originalTokens[tokenKey]) {
                        originalTokens[tokenKey] = tokenMatch[1];
                        localUpdated = true;
                    }

                    // Apply masking
                    if (originalTokens[tokenKey]) {
                        var maskedToken = 'Bearer ' + '*'.repeat(originalTokens[tokenKey].length);
                        span.textContent = span.textContent.replace(/Bearer \S+/i, maskedToken);
                    }
                });

                if (localUpdated) {
                    utils.setStoredTokens(originalTokens);
                }
            }

            // Improved function to unmask Bearer tokens
            function unmaskTokens() {
                var tokenSpans = utils.safeQuerySelectorAll(CONFIG.SELECTORS.TOKEN_SPANS);

                tokenSpans.forEach(function(span, index) {
                    if (!span.textContent.includes("Bearer")) return;

                    var tokenKey = 'Bearer' + index;
                    if (originalTokens[tokenKey]) {
                        span.textContent = span.textContent.replace(/Bearer \*+/i, 'Bearer ' + originalTokens[tokenKey]);
                    }
                });
            }

            // Improved function to mask access tokens
            function maskAccessToken() {
                var preElements = utils.safeQuerySelectorAll(CONFIG.SELECTORS.CODE_MIRROR_PRE);
                var localUpdated = false;

                preElements.forEach(function(pre, index) {
                    if (!pre.textContent.includes("Bearer <access_token>")) return;

                    var tokenKey = 'accessToken' + index;
                    
                    // Store original access token if not already stored
                    if (!originalTokens[tokenKey]) {
                        originalTokens[tokenKey] = "<access_token>";
                        localUpdated = true;
                    }

                    // Apply masking
                    var maskedAccessToken = "Bearer " + '*'.repeat("<access_token>".length);
                    pre.innerHTML = pre.innerHTML.replace(/Bearer &lt;access_token&gt;/g, maskedAccessToken);
                });

                if (localUpdated) {
                    utils.setStoredTokens(originalTokens);
                }
            }

            // Combined masking function
            function maskAllTokens() {
                maskTokens();
                maskAccessToken();
            }

            // Create debounced version for mutation observer
            var debouncedMask = utils.debounce(maskAllTokens, CONFIG.DEBOUNCE_DELAY);

            // Initial masking
            maskAllTokens();

            // Improved mutation observer with debouncing
            var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                var hasContentChanges = mutations.some(function(mutation) {
                    return mutation.type === 'childList' && 
                           (mutation.addedNodes.length > 0 || mutation.removedNodes.length > 0);
                });

                if (hasContentChanges) {
                    debouncedMask();
                }
            });

            // Observe with optimized configuration
            observer.observe(document.body, { 
                childList: true, 
                subtree: true,
                attributes: false,
                characterData: false
            });

            console.log('Token masking initialized successfully');

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error initializing token masking:', error);
        }
    }, CONFIG.INIT_DELAY); 
});

            document.location = PASSWORD_RESET_PATH;
        } else {
            document.location = '/page/password-reset';

        }
        $('#changePasswordMsg').hide();
    });
    if (window.location.href.indexOf("/page/api-key") > -1) {

        apiKeyScripts()
    }
    if (window.location.href.indexOf("/page/lender-mfa") > -1) {
        lenderMfa()
    }
    if (window.location.href.indexOf("/page/saml-sso") > -1) {
        samlSSO()
    }
    if (window.location.href.indexOf("/page/developer-forum") > -1) {
        window.open("https://resourcecenter.elliemae.com/resourcecenter/default.aspx?source=devconnect",'_blank');
    }

        samlSSOTest()
    }///page/flare
    if (window.location.href.indexOf("/page/flare") > -1) {

    }

function getCookie(c_name) {

        "keys": [
            {

                "base_idp_url": "https://idp.elliemae.com",
                "landing_url": "https://developer.elliemae.com",

                "forum_url": "https://forum.elliemae.com"
            }
        ]
    }
    return (JSON.stringify(hubUserData));
}

/*get all query parameters */
function getParameterByName(name, url) {
    if (!url) {
        url = window.location.href;
    }
    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
    var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + name + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)"),
        results = regex.exec(url);
    if (!results) return null;
    if (!results[2]) return '';
    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
}

//This function used for initial request to fetch the profile
function getClientId(token, regenerate) {
    if (token === undefined) {
        return;
    }
    var url;
    ebsToken = token;
    if (regenerate && regenerate === "true") {
        url = userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/oauth2/v1/clients?generateSecret=true';
    } else {

        url = userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/oauth2/v1/clients';
    }

    var errordiv = "apikey-error";
    var messagediv = "apikey-message";
    //var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + userData.keys[0].api_key;
    var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + token;

    $.ajax({
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': bearerAuthHeader
        },
        type: "GET",
        url: url,
        cache: false,
        timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (data) {
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "";
            if (typeof data.secret == 'undefined') {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Missing client secret from server";
                return;
            }
            if (typeof data.clientId == 'undefined') {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Missing client id from server";
            }
            document.getElementById("client-id").value = data.clientId;
            lastClientId = data.clientId;
            lastClientSecretMask = data.secret.substr(0, 8) + "********************************************************";
            document.getElementById("client-secret").value = data.secret;
            document.getElementById("client-secret-mask").value = lastClientSecretMask;


            lastClientSecret = data.secret;
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "Note:API credentials are specific to Encompass client id.";
            if (regenerate && regenerate === "true") {
                document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "Regenerated the secret.";
            } else {
                if (data.supportSecretChange && data.supportSecretChange === "true")
                    $('#generate-secret').show();
            }
        },
        error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "";
            document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server error!.";
            if (err.statusText.toLowerCase().trim() === "error") {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server could not process the request. Please check you have used super admin credentials!"
            } else {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(err.statusText);
            }
            if (err.status == 401) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml("(http   " + err.status + ")  " + err.statusText + "  try logout and login back! ");
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                logoutEBS();
            }, 5000);
        }
    });
}

//copy clientid and secret to clipboard for easy copy
function copyclientid() {
    var copyText = $("#client-id").val();
    setClipboardText(copyText);
}

function copyclientsecret() {
    var copyText = $("#client-secret").val();
    setClipboardText(copyText);
}

function setClipboardText(text) {
    var id = "mycustom-clipboard-textarea-hidden-id";
    var existsTextarea = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!existsTextarea) {
        console.log("Creating textarea");
        var textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
        textarea.id = id;
        // Place in top-left corner of screen regardless of scroll position.
        textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textarea.style.top = 0;
        textarea.style.left = 0;

        // Ensure it has a small width and height. Setting to 1px / 1em
        textarea.style.width = '1px';
        textarea.style.height = '1px';

        // We don't need padding, reducing the size if it does flash render.
        textarea.style.padding = 0;

        // Clean up any borders.
        textarea.style.border = 'none';
        textarea.style.outline = 'none';
        textarea.style.boxShadow = 'none';

        // Avoid flash of white box if rendered for any reason.
        textarea.style.background = 'transparent';
        document.querySelector("body").appendChild(textarea);
        console.log("The textarea now exists :)");
        existsTextarea = document.getElementById(id);
    } else {
        console.log("The textarea already exists :3")
    }

    existsTextarea.value = text;
    existsTextarea.select();

    try {
        var status = document.execCommand('copy');
        if (!status) {
            console.error("Cannot copy text");
        } else {
            console.log("The text is now on the clipboard");
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.log('Unable to copy.');
    }
}

    $('.Content-Wrapper').remove();

        document.getElementById("client-id").value = lastClientId;
        document.getElementById("client-secret").value = lastClientSecret;
        document.getElementById("client-secret-mask").value = lastClientSecretMask;
    }
}

/*This function used for getting the client id token */
function getMFAConfig(token) {

    //resetPasswordFileds();
    //document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "block";
    var url = userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/mfa/v1/realms/current/providers';
    var errordiv = "api-error";
    var messagediv = "api-message";
    var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + token;
    $("#local-spinner").show();

    $.ajax({
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': bearerAuthHeader
        },
        type: "GET",
        url: url,
        cache: false,
        timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (data) {
            $("#local-spinner").hide(1000);

            if (data.length > 0) {
                mfaSelection = data[0].providerName;
                providerId = data[0].providerId;
                providerName = data[0].providerName;
                selectMFA("start-" + providerName);
                selectedProviderName = providerName;
                document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";
                document.getElementById("lender-mfa-id").style.display = "block";
                document.getElementById('mfa-config').style.display = "block";


                //reset all
                document.getElementById("pingid-config").style.display = "none";
                $(".action-button-class").each(function () {
                    $(this).show();
                });
                document.getElementById("okta-config").style.display = "none";
                document.getElementById("duo-config").style.display = "none";

                if (data[0].providerName === "pingid") {
                    var radiobtn = document.getElementById("pingid-selection");
                    radiobtn.checked = true;

                }

                if (data[0].providerName === "None (Bypass)") {
                    document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "ByPass MFA is manually turned on!";
                    var radiobtn = document.getElementById("pingid-selection");
                    radiobtn.checked = true;

                }

                if (data[0].providerName === "okta") {
                    oktaObject = data[0].okta;
                    var radiobtn = document.getElementById("okta-selection");
                    radiobtn.checked = true;
                    document.getElementById("okta-api-token-id").value = oktaObject.apiToken;
                    document.getElementById("okta-org-url-id").value = oktaObject.orgUrl;
                    document.getElementById("okta-profile-custom-property-id").value = oktaObject.userPropertyName;


                }
                if (data[0].providerName === "duo") {
                    duoObject = data[0].duo;
                    console.log(JSON.stringify(duoObject));
                    var radiobtn = document.getElementById("duo-selection");
                    radiobtn.checked = true;
                    document.getElementById("duo-api-host-name-id").value = duoObject.apiHostName;
                    document.getElementById("duo-integration-key-id").value = duoObject.integrationKey;
                    document.getElementById("duo-secret-key-id").value = duoObject.secretKey;
                    if (duoObject.userNameMatch === 'FullyQualified') {
                        document.getElementById("simple-user-id").checked = false;
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById("simple-user-id").checked = true;

                    }

                }


            }

        },
        error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
            $("#local-spinner").hide(1000);
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "";
            document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server error!.";
            if (err.statusText.toLowerCase().trim() === "error") {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server could not process the request. Please check you have used super admin credentials!"
            } else {
                //document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(err.statusText);
            }
            if (err.status == 401) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml("(http   " + err.status + ")  " + err.statusText + "  try logout and login back! ");
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                logoutEBS();
            }, 5000);
        }
    });
}

function updateMFAConfig(token) {
    clearMessages();
    resetPasswordFileds();
    document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "block";
    var errordiv = "api-error";
    var messagediv = "api-message";
    var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + token;
    var parameters = {};
    parameters.providerId = providerId;
    parameters.providerName = mfaSelection;
    if (mfaSelection === "duo") {
        parameters.duo = {};
        parameters.duo.apiHostName = $("#duo-api-host-name-id").val();
        parameters.duo.integrationKey = $("#duo-integration-key-id").val();
        parameters.duo.secretKey = $("#duo-secret-key-id").val();
        if (document.getElementById("simple-user-id").checked === true) {
            parameters.duo.userNameMatch = "Simple";
        } else {
            parameters.duo.userNameMatch = "FullyQualified";
        }
    }
    if (mfaSelection === "okta") {
        parameters.okta = {};
        parameters.okta.apiToken = $("#okta-api-token-id").val();
        parameters.okta.orgUrl = $("#okta-org-url-id").val();
        parameters.okta.userPropertyName = $("#okta-profile-custom-property-id").val();

    }
    var p = JSON.stringify(parameters);
    var url = userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/mfa/v1/realms/current/providers/' + providerId;
    $("#local-spinner").show();
    $.ajax({
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': bearerAuthHeader
        },
        type: "PUT",
        url: url,
        cache: false,
        timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
        data: p,
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (data) {
            $("#local-spinner").hide(5000);
            console.log("Provider updated successfully" + this.url);
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "Provider changed successfully.";
            document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";


        },
        error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
            $("#local-spinner").hide(5000);
            document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";
            if (err.status == 202) {
                document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "Your Provider is updated.";
                document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "Provider changed successfully.";
                document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";
                //getMFAConfig(ebsToken)
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "";
            }
            if (err.status == 401) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml("(http   " + err.status + ")  " + err.statusText + "  try sign out and sign in back!. ");
            }
            if (err.status == 400) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(err.responseJSON.details);
            }
        }
    });
}

function viewToken() {
    var tokenInput = document.getElementById('okta-api-token-id');
    var tokenStatus = document.getElementById('token-status');
    if (tokenInput.type == 'password') {
        tokenInput.type = 'text';
        tokenStatus.className = 'fa fa-eye-slash fa-2x';
    } else {
        tokenInput.type = 'password';
        tokenStatus.className = 'fa fa-eye fa-2x';
    }
}

function viewSecretkey() {
    var secretkeyInput = document.getElementById('duo-secret-key-id');
    var secretkeyStatus = document.getElementById('secretkey-status');
    if (secretkeyInput.type == 'password') {
        secretkeyInput.type = 'text';
        secretkeyStatus.className = 'fa fa-eye-slash fa-2x';
    } else {
        secretkeyInput.type = 'password';
        secretkeyStatus.className = 'fa fa-eye fa-2x';
    }
}

    var tokenInput = document.getElementById('okta-api-token-id');
    var secretkeyInput = document.getElementById('duo-secret-key-id');
    tokenInput.type = "text";
    secretkeyInput.type = "text";
    viewSecretkey();
    viewToken();


}

                },
                type: "POST",
                //url: userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/oauth2/v1/token',
                url: userData.keys[0].base_api_url  + '/oauth2/v1/token',
                cache: false,
                timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
                data: p,
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (data) {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('borrowerToken', data.access_token);
                    sessionStorage.setItem('env', userData.keys[0].base_api_url );
                    ebsToken = data.access_token;
                    $.getJSON("https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html/asset-manifest.json", function (asset) {

                        var link1 = document.createElement('link');
                        link1.rel = 'stylesheet';
                        link1.href = 'https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html' + asset.files['main.css'];

                        var scr = document.createElement('script');
                        scr.type = 'text/javascript';
                        scr.src = 'https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html' + asset.files['main.js'];


                        document.head.appendChild(link1);
                        document.head.appendChild(scr);

                    });
                    document.getElementById("idp-config").style.display = "block";
                    document.getElementById("federation-api-key").style.display = "none";
                    document.getElementById("saml-root").style.display = "block";
                    $("#local-spinner").hide(1000);                
                    /*document.getElementById("idp-config").style.display = "block";
                    document.getElementById("federation-api-key").style.display = "block";
                    document.getElementById("saml-root").style.display = "block";
                    $("#local-spinner").hide(1000);*/
                    /* get token */
                    /*getClientIdSSO(ebsToken);*/

                },
                error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
                    document.getElementById("samlsso-error").innerHTML = "Access token not issued from the server. Please check your entitlement.";
                }
            });
        }

    }








}


/*This function used for getting the client id token */
function getClientIdSSO(token) {

    
    var url = userData.keys[0].base_api_url  + '/oauth2/v1/clients?federationClient=true';

    var errordiv = "apikey-error";
    var messagediv = "apikey-message";
    var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + token;

    $.ajax({
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': bearerAuthHeader
        },
        type: "GET",
        url: url,
        cache: false,
        timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (data) {
            document.getElementById("idp-config").style.display = "block";
            document.getElementById("federation-api-key").style.display = "block";
            document.getElementById("saml-root").style.display = "block";
            /*document.getElementById("ebs-instance-id").style.display = "block";*/
            /*document.getElementById("federation-client-id").style.display = "block";*/
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "";
            if (typeof data.clientId == 'undefined') {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Missing client id from server";
            }
            /*document.getElementById("federation-client-id").innerHTML = "<b>API Key Client ID for SSO</b><br>" + sanitizeHtml(data.clientId);*/
            /*document.getElementById("ebs-instance-id").innerHTML = "<b>Instance ID</b><br>" + sanitizeHtml(data.ebsInstanceId);*/
             $("#local-spinner").hide(1000);
            /* get Application */
            /*getApplications(token);*/


        },
        error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
            document.getElementById(messagediv).innerHTML = "";
            document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server error!.";
            if (err.statusText.toLowerCase().trim() === "error") {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server could not process the request. Please check you have used super admin credentials!"
            } else {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(err.statusText);
            }
            if (err.status == 401) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml("(http   " + err.status + ")  " + err.statusText + "  try logout and login back! ");
            }
            if (err.status == 403) {
                document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "FORBIDDEN";
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                logoutEBS();
            }, 5000);

        }
    });
}

/*This function used for initialing applications used*/
function getApplications(token) {

    console.log("getApplications(token)");
    var url = baseURL + '/saml2/v1/realms/current/applications';

    var errordiv = "apikey-error";
    var messagediv = "apikey-message";
    var bearerAuthHeader = 'Bearer ' + token;

    $.ajax({
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': bearerAuthHeader
        },
        type: "GET",
        url: url,
        cache: false,
        timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (data) {
            document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";

            var applications = data;
            samlRegisteredApplicationCount = applications.length;
            if (applications.length !== 0) {
                document.getElementById("applications-id").style.display = "block";
            }
            for (var i = 0; i < applications.length; i++) {
                $("#applications").append('<div>' + applications[i].name + '</div>');
            }

        },
        error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
            document.getElementById("local-spinner").style.display = "none";

            if (err.status !== 404) {
                if (err.statusText.toLowerCase().trim() === "error") {
                    document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = "Server could not process the request. Please check you have used super admin credentials!"
                } else {
                    document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(err.statusText);
                }
                if (err.status == 401 || err.status == 403) {
                    document.getElementById(errordiv).innerHTML = sanitizeHtml("(http   " + err.status + ")  " + err.statusText + "  try logout and login back! ");
                }
            }
        }

    });
};

function samlSSOTest() {

    /* create variables for baseURL and Page location */
    var pagelocation = "/developer-connect/page/sso-testing";
    //Need to get access token from user-data session
    /*Session Token */
    var sessionData = getCookie('user_data');
    userData = "";
    if (sessionData == "") {
        document.getElementById("samlsso-error").innerHTML = "Please Login";
    } else {
        userData = JSON.parse(sessionData);
    }

    /* document ready function */
    {
        document.getElementById("saml-wrapper").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("federation-api-key").style.display = "none";
        var myhost = 'https://' + document.location.host + pagelocation;
        var clientId = 'fzje72g2';


        sessionData = getCookie('user_data');
        if (sessionData == "") {
            document.getElementById("samlsso-error").innerHTML = "Please Login";
        } else {
            userData = JSON.parse(sessionData);
            if (userData.keys == undefined) {
                alert("Please login as valid ICE Mortgage Technology developer!");
                return;
            }
        }
        /* handled login */
        $("#samlebsLogin").click(function () {
            document.location = userData.keys[0].base_idp_url + '/authorize?client_id=' + clientId + '&response_type=code&redirect_uri=' + myhost + '&scope=lp';
        });

        $("#samlebsCancel").click(function () {
            ebsCancel();
        });


        /* get the code parameter by name */
        var code = getParameterByName('code');

        if (code != null) {
            //make all the div not displayed before authendication
            document.getElementById("mainsection").style.display = "none";
            document.getElementById("idp-config").style.display = "block";
            document.getElementById("federation-api-key").style.display = "none";
            var p = 'grant_type=authorization_code&scope=lp&redirect_uri=' + myhost + '&code=' + code + '&client_id=' + clientId;
            if (callcount === 1) {
                return;
            }
            callcount = 1;
            $.ajax({
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                },
                type: "POST",
                //url: userData.keys[0].base_api_url + '/oauth2/v1/token',
                url: userData.keys[0].base_api_url  + '/oauth2/v1/token',
                cache: false,
                timeout: 120000,  //120 seconds
                data: p,
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (data) {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('borrowerToken', data.access_token);
                    sessionStorage.setItem('env', userData.keys[0].base_api_url );
                    ebsToken = data.access_token;
                    $.getJSON("https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html/asset-manifest.json", function (asset) {

                        var link1 = document.createElement('link');
                        link1.rel = 'stylesheet';
                        link1.href = 'https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html/' + asset['main.css'];

                        var scr = document.createElement('script');
                        scr.type = 'text/javascript';
                        scr.src = 'https://developer.elliemae.com/readme/html/' + asset['main.js'];


                        document.head.appendChild(link1);
                        document.head.appendChild(scr);

                    });


                    /* get token */
                    getClientIdSSO(ebsToken);

                },
                error: function (err, textStatus, exception) {
                    document.getElementById("samlsso-error").innerHTML = "Access token not issued from the server. Please check your entitlement.";
                }
            });
        }

    }
}

//Auto selects this project in the search filter
window.addEventListener("load", (event) => {
    const clickExample = () => {
        // Find all labels within the project
        const labels = document.querySelectorAll('#AppSearch label');
        // Look for the label that contains the text "Encompass Developer Connect"
        const targetLabel = Array.from(labels).find(label => label.textContent.trim() === "Encompass Developer Connect");
        if (targetLabel) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            // Click the associated input if it hasn't already been clicked (checked)
            const input = targetLabel.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
            if (input && !input.checked) {
                input.click();
            }
        }
    };
    const interval = setInterval(clickExample, 500);
});
